title: consistent words
rule: Use the same command words in every menu, dialog, or flow for the same action; add a noun when the verb alone is ambiguous.
pass_when: The same action uses the same words across menus, dialogs, and flows; a noun is added when the verb alone is ambiguous.
fail_when: The same action is labeled differently in different places, or an ambiguous verb stands alone.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
